name: Game Lib
author: Gregory Medici
description: Your Steam library and browser-playable games in one Omarchy bar panel. Steam data is read from local caches, so it works offline and needs no API key.

barWidget.description: Search and launch Steam games, cloud-gaming services, and browser games without leaving the bar.

schema.label: Recently played shown
schema.description: How many recently played games to pin above the full library.

schema.label: Show web games
schema.description: Include cloud gaming, the curated catalogue, and itch.io.

schema.label: itch.io games indexed
schema.description: Browser-playable games pulled from itch.io. Set to 0 to skip the scrape entirely.

schema.label: Show cover art
schema.description: Use Steam's cached box art in the list. Turn off for a plain text list.

schema.label: Include tools and runtimes
schema.description: Also list Proton builds, Steam runtimes, and other non-games.

schema.label: Steam Web API key (optional)
schema.description: Only needed to list games you own but have never installed or launched on this machine. Get one at steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey.
